```{r setup, include=FALSE}
                      message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(spatialss)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(dplyr)
library(SpatialRDD)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(tmap)
library(rdd)
library(rddapp)
library(rdrobust)
```

## 加载 RDD 复制数据

```{r}
# 加载 Kenya Luhya RDD 数据
luhya_data <- load_rdd_data("luhya")
```

```{r}
# 加载 Palestine RDD 数据
palestine_data <- load_rdd_data("palestine")
head(palestine_data)
```

## 基本断点回归

```{r}
# 查看数据结构
str(palestine_data)
```

```{r}
# 使用 rddtools 进行断点回归
library(rddtools)

# 准备数据
rdd_data <- rdd_data(
  y = palestine_data$y,
  x = palestine_data$x,
  cutpoint = 0
)
summary(rdd_data)
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=6, fig.height=4.5}
# 断点图
plot(rdd_data,
     main = "RDD Plot",
     xlab = "Distance from Border (km)",
     ylab = "Outcome")
```

```{r}
# 估计断点回归模型
rdd_model <- rdd_reg_lm(rdd_data, slope = "separate")
summary(rdd_model)
```

## 使用 rdrobust 进行稳健估计

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=6, fig.height=4.5}
library(rdrobust)

rdrobust_result <- rdrobust(
  y = palestine_data$y,
  x = palestine_data$x,
  c = 0
)
summary(rdrobust_result)

# 断点图
rdplot(y = palestine_data$y,
       x = palestine_data$x,
       c = 0,
       title = "RD Plot - rdrobust",
       x.label = "Distance from Border",
       y.label = "Outcome")
```

## 空间断点回归 (Spatial RDD)

```{r eval=FALSE}
# 使用 SpatialRDD 包进行空间地理断点回归
library(SpatialRDD)

# 基本步骤：
# 1. 定义边界（border）作为断点
# 2. 计算每个观测点到边界的距离
# 3. 根据距离边界的位置分配处理组/对照组
# 4. 估计断点回归模型

# 示例：创建空间边界
border_points <- matrix(c(...), ncol = 2)
border_line <- st_linestring(border_points)

# 计算距离
distances <- st_distance(observations, border_line)
```

## 带宽选择

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=6, fig.height=4.5}
# 不同带宽下的估计结果比较
bw_choices <- c(10, 20, 30, 50)
bandwidth_results <- lapply(bw_choices, function(bw) {
  rdrobust(y = palestine_data$y,
           x = palestine_data$x,
           c = 0,
           h = bw)
})

names(bandwidth_results) <- paste0("bw=", bw_choices)
sapply(bandwidth_results, function(x) x$coef[1])
```

## 平衡性检验

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=6}
# 在断点处检验前定变量的连续性
# 确保处理组和对照组在基线协变量上没有系统性差异
if ("covariate" %in% names(palestine_data)) {
  bal_test <- rdrobust(
    y = palestine_data$covariate,
    x = palestine_data$x,
    c = 0
  )
  summary(bal_test)
}
```

## 安慰剂检验

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=6}
# 在非断点位置进行安慰剂检验
placebo_cutoffs <- seq(-20, 20, 5)
placebo_cutoffs <- placebo_cutoffs[placebo_cutoffs != 0]

placebo_results <- sapply(placebo_cutoffs, function(cut) {
  est <- rdrobust(y = palestine_data$y,
                  x = palestine_data$x,
                  c = cut)
  c(cutoff = cut, coef = est$coef[1], pval = est$pv[1])
})

t(placebo_results)
```
